title: 4731 Saddlebrook Drive Benbrook, TX | ColdwellBankerHomes.com
description:

4731 Saddlebrook Drive, Benbrook, TX

Map it at https://www.google.com/maps/place/4731+Saddlebrook+Drive,+Benbrook,+TX



Coldwell Banker 

ColdwellBankerHomes.com

Nestled in the highly desirable Meadows subdivision of Benbrook. Situated on over a quarter of an acre with no rear neighbors, this beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers the perfect combination of comfort, space, and convenience. Inside, youll find a versatile floor plan featuring two spacious living areas, two dining areas, and a warm, inviting wood-burning fireplace. The kitchen is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, complete with granite countertops, a center island, an eat-in bar, a built-in desk and workstation, and a stunning oversized skylight that fills the space with natural light. The private primary suite is a relaxing retreat with dual vanities, a jetted soaking tub, and generous walk-in closets. Plantation shutters throughout the home add timeless style and energy efficiency. Major updates provide peace of mind, including a new roof, water heater, driveway and sidewalk, two newer HVAC systems and windows, and two solar-powered attic fans. Step outside to enjoy the covered patio overlooking the private backyard with no rear neighbors, an ideal space for relaxing or entertaining. Conveniently located with easy access to Loop 820, downtown Fort Worth and Lockheed Martin, this home offers an exceptional location and maintains the charm of an established neighborhood. Residents of The Meadows enjoy a true sense of community with friendly and welcoming neighbors that make this neighborhood feel like home. This move-in ready home has been meticulously cared for and is ready for its next owners to enjoy.
